title: Material closeup
idea: Material closeup: A contextual object view transitions into a magnified material detail with a plain explanation of its relevance.
audience: People who need to judge material within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Finish, construction or material is a real purchase consideration.
avoidWhen: Generated texture would be mistaken for manufacturing evidence.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic craft layout through its judge material priority and explicit commitment contract: State which material and finish are actually offered and avoid false color fidelity.
navigation: Material closeup keeps the current judge material context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A contextual object view transitions into a magnified material detail with a plain explanation of its relevance.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to judge material; finish, construction or material is a real purchase consideration.
composition.priority: State which material and finish are actually offered and avoid false color fidelity.

imagery.role: Support the actual judge material context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Pair the close crop with its scale/context instead of using a full-screen unlabelled texture.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the material closeup structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no judge material content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; State which material and finish are actually offered and avoid false color fidelity.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized judge material content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: State which material and finish are actually offered and avoid false color fidelity.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active judge material context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
